quotations.old_english: Ðá on ðæm tweón ðe hié swá ungeorne his willan fulleodon
quotations.latin: qui fastidiose ducem in disponendo bello audientes

quotations.old_english: Ðæt hé tó ungeorne bewiste hwæt hé on þeóstrum dyde

source_text: un-georne; adv. I. unwillingly, reluctantly :-- Ðá on ðæm tweón ðe hié swá ungeorne his willan fulleodon qui fastidiose ducem in disponendo bello audientes, Ors 3, 11; Swt. 146, 24. II. without diligence, negligently :-- Ðæt hé tó ungeorne bewiste hwæt hé on þeóstrum dyde, Blickl. Homl. 183, 23. [O. H. Ger. un-gerno: Ger. un-gern: Icel. ú-gjarna unwillingly.]
